kind: finite direct-parent data interface; no executable wrapper supplied

clock_descriptor_shape.scope: same running local Mac only; CPython >=3.10

clock_resolution_rule: Replace null with actual time.get_clock_info('monotonic').resolution. Hash sorted compact ensure_ascii JSON with allow_nan=false plus one newline. Compare the actual full descriptor, not just its name. Bind same local host and boot through direct-parent topology; descriptor hash alone is not host identity.
closed_observer_steps: Before spawn: qualify the trusted runtime/version/local host and descriptor; retain exact collector/payload/profile hashes and planned new local run path; set S=time.monotonic_ns(), A=S+135000000000.

Construct exactly the nine-flag collector CLI with --envelope-start-ns=S and --clock-sha256 bound above. Retain its actual direct Popen handle. Use DEVNULL stdin/stdout/stderr for this collector; its remote SSH receives the separate pinned payload FD. No shell or additional process.
Immediately after spawn returns, sample local monotonic_ns. If already >=A, reject. A blocked spawn cannot establish timely completion. Do not start a replacement collector.

One actual handle.wait(timeout=max(0,(A-time.monotonic_ns())/1000000000)). On TimeoutExpired, return FAILED_UNVERIFIED bounded data with actual_exit=null unless a subsequent immediate nonblocking actual handle.poll returns a real code; any such observation still must be <A. No watcher, repeated wait, retry or indefinite wrapper.

After a successful actual wait/poll, record the returned code, then immediately T=time.monotonic_ns() BEFORE receipt reads or writes. Retain actual handle identity, resolved observer Python path/version, descriptor, S, A, T and timeout facts. Reject T>=A even if receipt says TRANSPORT_COMPLETE. No exit code inferred from PID/files.

Only an independently observed actual collector exit0 with T<A can reach receipt assessment. Read at most32KiB receipt and16KiB guard with no-follow/nonblocking regular-file checks and caps DURING reads. Assess exact bound hashes/clock/deadline arithmetic, actual SSH exit0, real both EOF, no cap/drop/timeout/publication failure, complete prefix hashes/lengths and guard durability. Reject any missing/stale/partial fact.

Apply separately pinned payload receipt and unchanged full parent artifact/source/copy predicates. Publish through the already bound R9 reserved writer/accounting path where required. This adapter supplies no artifact acceptance. Missing inputs stay unresolved.
observer_record_publication: parent's existing bounded/reserved writer; this contract does not implement one
later_process_variant: A later trusted same-Mac CPython>=3.10 may qualify an already retained actual collector OS-exit record and then sample the same clock, strictly before A. The earlier real OS-exit record is mandatory; a file COMPLETE flag is not an OS-exit record. Reject every observation >=A.
cooperative_OS_stall_limit: Spawn/wait/poll/clock/filesystem/scheduler calls can stall. Late or missing observation rejects acceptance. This recipe gives no hard preemption or universal process cleanup, and starts no new watcher.
